notTokenised.name: @media copies of --_fonts---*

notTokenised.name: Finsweet consent --fs-cc-*
notTokenised.why: vendor (@finsweet cookie-consent) variables, not product design tokens; the layer itself is measured under component.marketing

notTokenised.name: --tx/--ty/--dot-size/--dot-gap
notTokenised.why: runtime translate/density plumbing for the logo strips and dot pattern; recorded under core.heroSlider as raw values, not scales
